title: Beyond the Log-Linear Frontier: Pre-Asymptotic Analysis of Finite-Budget Neural Scaling Laws
abstract: arXiv:2611.13534v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Classical neural scaling laws model excess risk as a separable power law in model capacity $N$ and dataset size $D$. At finite budgets, however, empirical learning curves and compute-optimal allocations depart from this log-linear frontier. This paper analyzes how spectral and domain heterogeneity govern these finite-scale departures. Along the capacity axis, Mellin--Barnes analysis of covariance resolvents yields a three-term expansion where competing spectral and regularization modes produce finite-scale curvature and logarithmic transitions. Because fitting multiple power laws on narrow pilot grids is ill-conditioned, we eliminate the loss floor via first-order Aitken differencing to obtain a well-conditioned closed-form initializer. Along the data axis, KKT duality reduces $K$-domain mixing to scalar water-filling, yielding finite-budget bottleneck bounds, an online sampling curriculum, and a simplex Hessian metric for cross-domain t

translated_title: 超越对数线性前沿：有限预算神经缩放定律的前渐近分析
translated_abstract: 经典的神经缩放定律将超额风险建模为模型容量 $N$ 与数据集规模 $D$ 的可分离幂律。然而在有限预算下，经验学习曲线与计算最优分配会偏离这一对数线性前沿。本文分析了谱异质性与域异质性如何主导这些有限规模的偏离。在容量轴上，通过对协方差预解式进行 Mellin--Barnes 分析，得到了一个三项展开式，其中相互竞争的谱模式与正则化模式产生了有限尺度曲率和对数式过渡。由于在狭窄的试点网格上拟合多个幂律是病态问题，我们利用一阶 Aitken 差分消除损失下限，从而获得良态的闭式初始化器。在数据轴上，KKT 对偶性将 $K$ 域混合问题化归为标量注水问题，由此导出有限预算的瓶颈界、在线采样课程以及用于跨域迁移的单纯形 Hessian 度量。
tldr: 本文通过 Mellin-Barnes 谱分析与 KKT 对偶理论刻画了有限预算下神经缩放定律偏离对数线性前沿的机制，提出了基于 Aitken 差分的良态闭式缩放定律估计方法，以及基于注水原理的多域数据最优采样策略。
en_tdlr: This paper characterizes pre-asymptotic deviations from log-linear neural scaling laws at finite budgets via Mellin-Barnes spectral analysis and KKT duality, yielding a well-conditioned closed-form scaling-law estimator based on Aitken differencing and a water-filling-based optimal multi-domain data sampling curriculum.
